description: Fondazione IPRES publishes puglia building stock by cadastral category, 2013–2020. Municipal building/property-unit totals and cadastral rents are divided into cadastral categories A–F for 2013–2020. The data come from the Revenue Agency’s property-market observatory. Individual building geometry, occupancy and engineering condition are not established. Coverage is the Puglia region of Italy. The native catalogue provides CSV and spreadsheet distributions, with some linked visualisations. These alternative representations remain one resource; file contents and data rows were not inspected. The native licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a stated version. The national metadata mirror specifies version 4.0; the native statement remains unversioned. Metadata access is public, while file-use charges and restrictions are not established. Completeness and numerical accuracy are unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related national and regional catalogue representations are treated as the same publication only where their exact source identities match.
